_comment: QM-0100. Every field below is a MEASURED value, read from files in this tree on 2026-08-05. Fields that no file in the tree records are null. models/ is gitignored, so this repository redistributes no weights; this record is what keeps the plan's numbers auditable after the checkpoint is deleted to reclaim disk. Verified by tests/tests/real_checkpoint_record.rs.
name: distilbert-distilgpt2
provenance_note: No file in this tree records where the checkpoint was fetched from or at which revision. models/distilbert-distilgpt2/README.md is the upstream model card and links to huggingface.co/gpt2, which is the teacher model, not this artifact's source or revision. Recorded as null rather than guessed.
licence_source: models/distilbert-distilgpt2/README.md — YAML front matter `license: apache-2.0` (line 6), corroborated by `- **License:** Apache 2.0` (line 36)
sha256_of_header_covers: the 8277 JSON header bytes at absolute file range [8, 8285). The leading little-endian u64 length prefix is NOT included. For the 8285-byte range [0, 8285) that does include the prefix, the digest is 20ed923e186530aab856708c7e06f600300114271f9c6bfa4b5071cef69dd50a. There is no model.safetensors.index.json to hash.
parameter_count_note: Sum of the product of every tensor's shape, from the header. It counts the six rank-4 causal-mask buffers, which are registered buffers rather than trainable parameters: 88204032 - (6 * 1048576) = 81912576, matching the 'has 82 million parameters' claim in the model card. Independent corroboration, not a derivation from this codebase.
rank4_note: ADR-010 caps the implemented visualization rank at 3 and requires rank > 3 to refuse rather than flatten. ADR-010 places that ceiling at the axis-binding / block / tile layers, NOT at the metadata layer: q_source::TensorDescriptor::shape is deliberately arbitrary-rank, so ingestion and `q inspect` list these six at their true [1,1,1024,1024] shape. The designed refusal, bindAxes() returning NotImplemented carrying GRID-007, is unimplemented in this tree and is owned by QM-0061 (and QM-0040 for the block planner). This checkpoint is the first real artifact that makes that refusal testable against real data.
coverage_not_established: Sharded read path — this checkpoint is a single file with no model.safetensors.index.json, so multi-shard attribution is NOT exercised by real data. It stays covered only by fixtures/tiny-llama-2shard and q-safetensors' ingests_a_sharded_checkpoint.
bf16 exact decode (SRC-016) — all 82 tensors are F32, so the bf16 path is NOT exercised by real data and stays covered by fixtures. SRC-014's fp8 refusal is likewise not exercised here.

MoE expert-keyed aggregation — GPT-2 has no experts, so there is NO real-checkpoint fixture for it. QM-0123 is provable only against generated fixtures and the deferred MOE-001 seam gains nothing from this checkpoint.

24 GB scale — this file is 352824413 bytes (~337 MiB). The plan's >= 24 GB scale claim is NOT established on real data. crates/q-catalog/tests/trillion_scale_manifest.rs remains metadata-only and opens no artifact.

measurement.byte_and_header_facts: exact — Python struct.unpack('<Q') + json.loads + math.prod over the header bytes, and os.path.getsize for the file length
